_comment: Tietokoneet (games/robotti, tietokone, robottitehdas): generated by tools/tietokoneet/gen-voice.ts, same ids as voice/fi.json.

clips.tk_r_askeleet: The robot's battery is empty. Make it a program: press the arrows, then start with the green button.
clips.tk_r_toista: The robot has only a few places for its program. Make the pattern once and choose how many times it repeats.
clips.tk_r_jos: The robot walks by itself. When it steps on a coloured square, it turns. Choose an arrow for each colour.
clips.tk_r_tormasi: Oops, the robot crashed! The red arrow is a bug, a mistake. Fix it.
clips.tk_r_tormasi_jos: Oops, the robot crashed! Check the arrows of the colours.
clips.tk_r_ei_perille: The program ended, but the battery is still far away. Add more steps.
clips.tk_r_ikuinen: The robot goes round and round and never gets there.
clips.tk_r_vihje_askeleet: Follow the yellow dots. The first arrow is
clips.tk_r_vihje_toista: Look at the purple dots. That is the pattern that repeats. Make it once and count how many times it fits on the way.
clips.tk_r_vihje_jos: The white arrow shows where the path goes after the coloured square.
clips.tk_t_rakenna: Build a phone. Drag the parts onto their shadows.
clips.tk_t_missa: Does it run in the phone or in the cloud?
clips.tk_t_vihje_varjo: Look at the shape of the shadow. Every part has its own place.
clips.tk_t_puhelin_valmis: The phone is ready, and it turns on!
clips.tk_t_vihje_p: This doesn't need the internet. The phone can do it by itself.
clips.tk_t_vihje_c: This needs information from all over the world or a really big computer. Those are in the cloud.
clips.tk_t_n_cpu: processor, the brain of the device.
clips.tk_t_job_cpu: Which part counts and decides what to do? It is the brain of the device.
clips.tk_t_job_ram: Which part remembers what you are doing right now? When the power goes off, it forgets everything.
clips.tk_t_job_ssd: Which part keeps your photos and games, even when the power is off?
clips.tk_t_job_naytto: Which part shows pictures and games?
clips.tk_t_job_mikki: Which part hears you when you talk?
clips.tk_t_job_antenni: Which part talks with other devices without a wire?
clips.tk_t_vihje_cpu: Find the square with golden legs on its sides.
clips.tk_t_vihje_ram: Find the long green stick with black pieces.
clips.tk_t_vihje_ssd: Find the purple box. It is like a memory card.
clips.tk_t_vihje_akku: Find the green one with a lightning bolt.
clips.tk_t_vihje_naytto: Find the blue screen with a face.
clips.tk_t_vihje_kaiutin: Find the round black one where the sound comes out.
clips.tk_t_vihje_mikki: Find the little grey one you speak into.
clips.tk_t_vihje_kamera: Find the black one with an eye, a lens.
clips.tk_t_vihje_antenni: Find the stick that sends out waves.
clips.tk_t_th_videot: Videos from all over the world.
clips.tk_t_th_tekoaly: A big AI you can ask anything.
clips.tk_t_s_laskin: The calculator runs in the phone. The processor works it out by itself.
clips.tk_t_s_lamppu: The torch is in the phone. It turns on the light next to the camera.
clips.tk_t_s_videot: The videos are in the cloud, in big server halls with thousands of computers.
clips.tk_t_s_haku: Search runs in the cloud. The servers have read a huge number of web pages.
clips.tk_t_s_kello: The clock runs in the phone. It wakes you even with no internet.
clips.tk_t_s_saa: The weather is worked out in the cloud, from weather stations all over the world.
clips.tk_t_s_piirros: The drawing app runs in the phone. The picture is saved in its storage.
clips.tk_t_s_peli: This game runs in your phone, without the internet!
clips.tk_t_s_viesti: The message goes through the cloud. A server takes it to your friend's phone.
clips.tk_t_s_tekoaly: A big AI runs in the cloud. It needs many big computers at once.
clips.tk_t_s_kuva: The photo is taken in the phone, by the camera and the processor.
clips.tk_t_s_kartta: The traffic jams come from the cloud. It knows where all the cars are right now.
clips.tk_f_kokoa: Each robot in the cookie factory does one job. Put them in the right order and start the line.
clips.tk_f_tarkastaja: Sometimes the robots make bad cookies. Choose what the inspector checks. A bad cookie goes back to the start.
clips.tk_f_palaute: The inspector found a mistake. Tell the robot that made it. That's how it learns.
clips.tk_f_pullonkaula: Lots of customers today. See where the cookies pile up, and put a helper robot there.
clips.tk_f_kauppa: Making a cookie costs one euro, and a customer pays three euros for it. How many cookies shall we bake?
clips.tk_f_n_paketti: The packer puts the cookie in a box.
clips.tk_f_tayta: First put robots in all the places.
clips.tk_f_ei_hyva: Oops, the cookie came out funny.
clips.tk_f_vihje_muotti: Then the dough is made into shapes.
clips.tk_f_vihje_uuni: Then the cookies are baked in the oven.
clips.tk_f_valitse_tarkastus: First choose what the inspector checks.
clips.tk_f_vain_hyvia: The customers got only good cookies!
clips.tk_f_huono_paasi: Oh no, a bad cookie got to a customer.
clips.tk_f_vihje_tarkastus: Look at yesterday's cookies. Which ones did the customers not like?
clips.tk_f_oppi: The robot got the feedback and learned!
clips.tk_f_vihje_palanut: A burnt cookie was too long in the heat. Who bakes?
clips.tk_f_vihje_rikki: The star broke in the cutter. Who makes the shapes?
clips.tk_f_vihje_tyhja: The cookie has no sprinkles. Who decorates?
clips.tk_f_vihje_mytty: The dough is lumpy. Who mixes the dough?
clips.tk_f_katso_jono: See where the cookies piled up. That robot is too slow. Put a helper robot there.
clips.tk_f_vihje_jono: A helper only helps where there is a queue. The line is only as fast as its slowest robot.
clips.tk_f_kaikki_saivat: All the customers got their cookies!
clips.tk_f_ei_enempaa: No more helpers. Move one to another place.
clips.tk_f_leivo_ensin: First bake some cookies with the plus button.
clips.tk_f_liian_vahan_kekseja: The cookies ran out and some customers got none. You could have earned more.
clips.tk_f_liikaa_kekseja: Cookies were left over. Making them cost money, but nobody bought them.
clips.tk_f_vihje_kauppa: Count how many cookies the customers want altogether. Bake exactly that many.
